# Length

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Calculate the length of line features in specified units.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/length",
  "type": "LengthOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/length').par.geojson` (an input) and `op('/length').out.featureCollection` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.geojson`, `out.featureCollection`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `geojson` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `units` | `StringLiteralField` | `"kilometers"` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `featureCollection` | `GeoJsonField` |
| `totalLength` | `NumberField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
